description:
A 4-second vertical anime shot made to feel like a casual TikTok of a real guy, drawn in anime style. It is the 'real life' layer of an advert, deliberately plainer than a cinematic anime: handheld phone-camera framing, slightly imperfect composition, small natural movements, no dramatic lighting effects.

STYLE — modern slice-of-life TV anime: clean linework, soft flat cel shading, muted colours. The room is dark, lit only by a purple LED strip behind the desk and the cool white glow of his phone on his face. Not 3D, not glossy, not Western cartoon.

SETTING — a messy but likeable small bedroom at night, about 2:30 a.m. He sits on the edge of an unmade bed. Behind him: a desk with an open laptop whose screen shows only soft abstract light, a purple LED strip along the wall, a shelf of manga volumes with blank spines, one small anime figure on the shelf.

CHARACTER — a guy of about 19, messy dark-brown hair falling over his forehead, warm brown eyes, slight shadows under his eyes, expressive eyebrows. Oversized black hoodie, a thin silver chain, grey sweatpants. Approachable and a little chaotic, not a model.

THE PHONE — he holds exactly one black smartphone in both hands at chest height. Its screen faces him, away from the camera: we only ever see the back of the phone and its glow on his face.

TEXT RULE — no words, letters, numbers, logos or interface visible anywhere. The phone screen is never visible to camera.

SINGLE TAKE, handheld medium close-up, as if a friend is filming him:

1. (about 2.2 s) He stares down at the phone, then breaks into a disbelieving laugh, shoulders shaking, and his eyes flick up to the camera for a moment — 'are you seeing this?' — then back down to the phone. Gentle handheld drift.

2. (about 1.8 s) Still looking at the phone, he slowly shakes his head with a wide closed-mouth grin, thumb tapping the screen. Very slow handheld push in.

AUDIO: quiet night room tone, a faint electrical hum, the soft tap of a thumb on glass. No voices, no laughter sound, no music.
